scope: same five Izu islands; unseen terrestrial vascular plant taxa; taxon transfer only
secondary_endpoints: heldout points >=1 km from nearest training prototype
heldout points >=2 km from nearest training prototype

inference.primary_gate: hybrid-random mean >0, bootstrap lower95 >0, sign-flip p<0.05
inference.microclimate_gate: hybrid-NDVI-only bootstrap lower95 >0 and sign-flip p<0.05

decision_if_microclimate_gate_fails: Do not retune. If NDVI-only still beats random, support NDVI-state transfer but not the Campanula-tuned microclimate correction.
claim_boundary: No cross-region/universal claim and no SDM/GRTS/biosurvey superiority claim.
separation: Exclude every taxon in validation/practical_core_untouched_cohort_20260811/{excluded_taxa.csv,predeclared_taxon_region_pairs.csv} plus project-used focal taxa; do not consume the frozen 192-pair cohort.
pre_outcome_sampling_frame_correction: First sampling-only run used a GBIF MULTIPOLYGON rejected with HTTP 400. Second no-outcome run exposed one marine red alga in a Plantae-only frame. Before any focal occurrence rows, candidate generation, or held-out outcomes were retrieved, eligibility was frozen to GBIF phylum Tracheophyta and prior project focal taxa were explicitly excluded.
fingerprint_method: sha256 canonical JSON excluding fingerprint fields
